course_name_original: Projecto Integrador de 1º Ciclo em Engenharia de Telecomunicações e Informática
course_name_en: 1st Cycle Integrated Project in Telecommunications and Informatics Engineering
syllabus_topics: Scientific project: deep and academically rigorous analysis of a scientific, technological, or management challenge, potentially including experimental and/or computational work.
Project in a company: individual project focused on a specific challenge presented by the host company, requiring a solution or analysis geared towards short-term implementation.
JUNO Project: multidisciplinary team work based on real and complex problems/challenges presented by companies or institutions, requiring contributions from students of different IST/ULisboa courses.
institution: Universidade De Lisboa — LERC Eng. de Telecomunicações e Informática (IST)
degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia de Telecomunicações e Informática (LERC)
